player_intent: Keep a believable left wrist while gripping two-handed long guns.
acceptance_rule: Underhand roll uses physical up from trigger/barrel-base/muzzle sockets, never parent mount Y. Missing, nonfinite or collinear sockets skip roll refinement. M4/AK stationary carry/aim retain palm error below2cm, wrist bend below57degrees and ready bore below0.1degrees. Actions, pistols, mobility, mounts and finger curves retain prior owners.

ownership.support_hand: Existing SEAL weapon-pose strategy and socket IK

nodes.role: Refines the existing support solve without moving the gun or adding a bone writer.

must_not_change: Weapon transform owner and non-support sockets
visual_check: Close-up M4/AK carry and aim from both sides; palm supports underneath the fore-end, fingers wrap and wrist does not fold backward. Inspect skin, not only socket error.

system_delta.reason: Parent mount Y differs from physical gun-up by about85degrees on M4/AK. Derive underhand roll from existing physical sockets while preserving the bounded contact solve and all source/mount/finger assets. Socket distance alone does not prove skin grip.

current.system: Bounded support wrist using parent mount Y

candidate.system: Same bounded support wrist using physical socket frame
